Universal Lists
Create a universal list lists.add

items.docs: If you are developing integrations for Bitrix24 using AI tools (Codex, Claude Code, Cursor), connect to the [MCP server](../../../ai-tools/mcp.md) so that the assistant can utilize the official REST documentation. The `lists.add` method creates a universal list.

items.docs: If you are developing integrations for Bitrix24 using AI tools (Codex, Claude Code, Cursor), connect to the [MCP server](../../../ai-tools/mcp.md) so that the assistant can utilize the official REST documentation. The method `lists.element.update` updates a list element. The method completely overwrites the element. Fields whose values are not provided will be cleared.

info.name: Create a Field for Universal List lists.field.add

items.docs: If you are developing integrations for Bitrix24 using AI tools (Codex, Claude Code, Cursor), connect to the [MCP server](../../../ai-tools/mcp.md) so that the assistant can utilize the official REST documentation. The method `lists.field.add` creates a list field. You can find the available field types for the universal list using the method [lists.field.type.get](./lists-field-type-get.md)
